name: Chicken Nugget Parmesan Sliders with Cucumber-Tomato Salad (Kid-Friendly)

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).

Arrange chicken nuggets on the baking sheet. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until nuggets are crispy and heated through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven and transfer chicken nuggets to a plate. (Reserve baking sheet and foil for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and slice cucumber crosswise into thin rounds. Place in a medium bowl.

Wash, dry, and halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the cucumber, along with oil and salt. Stir to combine the salad and set aside. (Alternatively, the salad can be left undressed if a simpler preparation is preferred.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 pint grape tomatoes
1 tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place egg in a small bowl, whisk to combine, and set aside.
Stack cheese slices one on top of another, then cut into quarters.

Split rolls in half. Place bottom halves of the rolls, cut-side up, on the reserved baking sheet. Spread each with 1 tablespoon marinara sauce, then sprinkle with 1 tablespoon Parmesan. Top with a chicken nugget and 2 pieces of the provolone. Close with the top half of each roll.
instructions.secondary_message:
8 Hawaiian sweet rolls
½ cup marinara sauce
½ cup Parmesan cheese, shredded

instructions.primary_message: Brush the tops of the rolls with egg wash, then sprinkle with Italian seasoning and garlic powder.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ tsp Italian seasoning
⅛ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven and bake until the cheese is melted and filling is warmed through, 4-5 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide sliders and salad between plates. Enjoy!
